description:
MJPJAY stands for Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana. 

It is a health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for healthcare services to the economically weaker sections of society. 

The objective is to reduce the out-of-pocket expenditure on health and improve access to quality healthcare. 

The scheme offers coverage for hospitalization expenses up to a specified limit. 

It includes pre and post-hospitalization expenses as well as expenses for surgeries and treatments. 

Eligible beneficiaries receive cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals. 

The eligibility criteria include being a resident of Madhya Pradesh and belonging to a low-income family. 

Families with an annual income below a certain threshold are eligible for the scheme. 

The application process involves filling out a form and submitting it at designated centers. 

Beneficiaries may also need to provide proof of income and identity documents. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Madhya Pradesh. 

The timeline for the application process is ongoing as the scheme is continuously available. 

The scheme is part of the broader initiative to enhance healthcare access in the state. 

It aims to cover a large number of families and improve health outcomes.
